name: FFN-Width Residual
scope: Optional ordinary full-attention vanilla; native and NVIDIA mHC remain unchanged and reject enabling this option.
user_correction: SwiGLU was illustrative. Keep the original ReLU-squared MLP, its parameters, dimensions and initialization.
read: r = RMSNorm(old_s, eps=1e-6) * RMS(z), independently per token over the FFN width
write: new_s = old_s + original_z; out of place, after reading old_s
state: [B,T,4D], zeros each forward; depth-local runtime tensor, never a parameter, buffer or checkpoint field; no detach
dtype: BF16 state/activations; FP32 RMS reductions (FP64 in oracle); exact zero RMS(z) uses vector_norm with finite zero subgradient
memory_caveat: Backward saves more than one live state. Actual training peak and elementwise overhead must be measured.

gate.profile: Same GPU, original FA3 full attention, B16 T2048 D512 depth8; baseline then enabled, each20 warmup+40 timed updates
gate.restart: Separate processes25 -> exit85 ->50; full305176-step LR horizon; exact optimizer/RNG tested separately with fixed gradients
gate.cache: Existing packed2K gate prefix, no new tokenization or large cache

limitations: Short checks do not establish convergence, long-run stability, or a quality advantage. No10B training is submitted by this workflow.
